entries.title: Move around Firstmate with F6 and the arrow keys
entries.body: F6 and ⇧F6 go between the parts of the window: your panels, the shown card and your message, or Settings' tabs and the open section, even from inside a card. In Tasks the arrow keys move through the list, a task's summary opens beside the row you're on, and Enter opens it. In Settings, ← and → change tabs. A soft ring shows where the keyboard is, and you can change F6 in Settings → Keyboard.

picture.alt: The Tasks list with the keyboard on a row, its ring drawn round it and the task's summary open beside it
